claim: Marks a cut as provisional so a work-in-progress is never mistaken for the finished film once it leaves your hands. draft for internal circulation, version_slate when notes need to cite a specific build, custom for client or festival marking, none only when you genuinely mean final.
not_visual: The mark is burned on by ffmpeg after generation and never by the diffusion model. Prompting 'watermark', 'artist name' or 'english text' would only demonstrate SDXL's garbled-lettering failure mode, which is the precise opposite of the clean legible overlay the option delivers - the card would teach the author to distrust a feature that works fine. Show it instead as an ffmpeg overlay applied over one identical render, four times.
